'''Watchwing''' was a [[Ruping/Legends|Ruping]] owned by [[Olko Baz]], a member of the [[Clazca]], a tribe of the [[Beast Riders]] on [[Onderon/Legends|Onderon]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].
